newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Soros sells stake in Moroccan Diwan for $17.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Soros sells stake in Moroccan Diwan for $17.6 mln.

text.p: U.S. businessman George Soros will sell a 6.07 percent stake in Morocco's portfolio firm Diwan on the Casablanca bourse for 165 million dirhams ($17.6 million), a Diwan spokesman said on Tuesday.
"Quantum Emerging Growth Partners fund decided to sell off nearly half of its stake in Financiere Diwan or 6.07 percent at 165 million dirhams," a spokesman for Diwan firm told a news conference.
Quantum fund, which is owned by Soros, will cede on the Casablanca stock 500,000 shares at 330 dirhams per share, the spokesman said.
The shares will be offered to the public from 26 to 30 May 1997 through banks or brokerage house, such as Casablanca Finance Group, he said.
